title: Terminal
description: The site's command line, with scripts in its own language, Lua and a POSIX shell.

actions.title: Open a Terminal
actions.description: Open a new Terminal for the person at the page, in a folder, and optionally run a command line there for them to see. The command's output appears in that Terminal and is not returned.

path.description: The folder the Terminal starts in, such as ~ or /site.

run.description: A command line to run once the Terminal is open.
